ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which letter corresponds to a seedling?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, the left side is a diagram of the life cycle of a plant: the letter D is marked next to a seed, the letter F is marked next to a small plant that has just sprouted, this small plant has a short stem and small leaves, and the letter A is marked next to a larger mature plant. The right side is an insect life cycle, unrelated to the plant seed-to-plant stage. According to the biological meaning, seedling refers to a young plant that has just grown from a seed, therefore it corresponds to the small newly sprouted plant in the figure, and the letter is F.
